newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Ihlas in joint deal with CMS Energy, Howard.
newsitem.headline: Turk Ihlas in joint deal with CMS Energy, Howard.

text.p: Turkey's blossoming Ihlas Holding has signed a protocol to set up partnership with U.S. CMS Energy and Howard Energy in Turkey's power distribution tenders, the Istanbul Stock Exchange said.

It quoted a company statement as saying that the deal, which will bring $300 million long-term credit into Turkey over an unspecified period of time, was reached during talks between the three companies in Detroit, U.S.
The partnership will be established if Ihlas, which has already participated in five power distribution tenders by Turkey's state power distributor TEDAS, wins any one or more of the tenders.
Ihlas will hold a 55-percent stake in the partnership, CMS Energy will hold 30 percent and Howard Energy 15, it said.
The capital of the partnership will determined later, it added.
